🚨 Ministers spent months claiming the NHS waiting list was finally falling. New figures say otherwise.

After bottoming at 7.01 million in March, it's risen for two months straight to 7.28 million in May. Just 65.6% of patients are treated within 18 weeks, against a 92% target.
